race.comment: UNLEASH HARRY (3) was well supported when resuming last start but missed the placings in fourth over 1100m at Gosford. Fitter now and will take some beating with that run under his belt out to this trip. COLD MIST (8) was in contention all the way and fought on for second last start over 1310m at Moruya, making it three minor placings in a row. Gets in light with Cole's claim and should be hitting his straps now. MAYLEIGH (6) showed good signs in her debut prep and has been fitted with two solid trials in readiness. Drawn nicely and can give this a big shake.  ZOUSARI (4) is close to breaking through after two consecutive placings, the latest coming when second over 1350m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Holds genuine claims. CAP D'AIL (1) is fitter for two runs back from a spell, progressing nicely last time to finish second at this track over 1200m. Should be at his peak now.
